newsitem.title: USA: Walden to buy back up to 1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Walden to buy back up to 1 mln shares.

text.p: Walden Residential Properties Inc said Friday that it has authorized the repurchase up to 1,000,000 shares of its common stock.
The company said the repurchase program will continue until it acquires the 1,000,000 shares or until December 31, 1998. Purchases will be made in the open market and through private transactions.
Under its previous 500,000 share repurchase program, Walden acquired 422,100 shares before the program's expiration on December 31, 1996.

Walden is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust which owns and manages 75 properties with 23,188 apartment units, principally located in Texas, Florida, Oklahoma, Arizona and Tennessee.
